content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling digital music online without relying on traditional payment platforms is not just a choice; it's a necessity for many creators worldwide. For those in regions cut off from services like Stripe and PayPal, establishing an independent sales system is crucial. This infrastructure allows you to accept crypto payments directly, ensuring you retain a larger portion of your earnings. Unlike conventional platforms that charge high fees—up to 10%—you can operate with a minimal cost structure, making your creations more profitable and accessible to your audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is built to be streamlined and efficient. It typically includes components such as Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, which processes orders automatically, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. This infrastructure operates independently of traditional payment gateways, ensuring you have full control. Your products, whether they are music tracks or templates, are hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages, enabling fast delivery without relying on third-party services. This setup not only enhances your operational efficiency but also guarantees that you own your customer data and sales history.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either restricted or expensive. If you're an artist, producer, or educator looking to sell music or courses online, this infrastructure empowers you to conduct business on your own terms. By leveraging cryptocurrency payments, you can reach a global audience without the barriers imposed by traditional financial systems. This approach is built for those who want to take control of their digital commerce without incurring excessive fees or losing ownership of their work.
Keep 99.5% of your sales revenue with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several key components that work in harmony. First, you have hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a reliable platform to showcase your products. Next, backend functionalities are handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating order processing. For payment handling, NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions, converting prices into local currency at the time of sale. With everything integrated, you can offer instant delivery of your digital products without the ongoing costs associated with traditional platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your music online, first determine your product offerings and set up your digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept Bitcoin and other digital currencies. Once your setup is complete, test the flow to ensure everything works from order placement to product delivery. Finally, promote your store to reach your target audience and maximize sales.

Platforms like NOWPayments facilitate this process with minimal fees. By setting up your own digital storefront, you gain complete control over your sales and retain a larger share of your profits.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell, such as music tracks or courses. Set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store. Implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Test the purchasing process to ensure smooth delivery of products. Promote your store to attract customers and start making sales.
